#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> n >> s;

    int maxOutside = 0, insideCount = 0, curLen = 0;
    bool inside = false;

    size_t i = 0;
    while (i < s.length()) {
        char c = s[i];
        switch (c) {
            case '(':
                maxOutside = std::max(maxOutside, curLen);
                curLen = 0;
                inside = true;
                break;
            case ')':
                inside = false;
                if (curLen > 0) {
                    insideCount++;
                    curLen = 0;
                }
                break;
            case '_':
                if (inside && curLen > 0) {
                    insideCount++;
                } else if (!inside) {
                    maxOutside = std::max(maxOutside, curLen);
                }
                curLen = 0;
                break;
            default:
                curLen++;
        }
        i++;
    }
    maxOutside = std::max(maxOutside, curLen);
    std::cout << maxOutside << " " << insideCount << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
